# rusolve agent reference

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_agent_docs.py from the built binary. Do not edit; run the script. A test (crates/rusolve-cli/tests/agent_docs.rs) fails when this file is stale. -->

Start with [llms.txt](../../llms.txt) and the skills in [docs/skills](../skills). This page lists every command, MCP tool, option and environment variable the binary knows.

## Exit codes

| code | meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | the command ran; the solve status is in the output, not in the code |
| 2 | usage error: unknown flag, missing value, bad `--opt`, unregistered `RUSOLVE_*` variable |
| 3 | input error: model file missing, unreadable or not parseable |
| 4 | internal error: the solver returned an error, or a requested output file could not be written |

Exit codes 2/3/4 apply on the port path (the default; `RUSOLVE_MIP_HIGHS=0` selects the native search) and the agent subcommands; the legacy native `solve` path still uses 0/1/2.

## Commands

Source: `rusolve --help --json`, the command registry that also drives `--help` and the option parser. `--format json` prints exactly one JSON object on stdout with a `schema_version`; logs go to stderr. Schemas live in `docs/schema/`.

| command | usage | what it does | output schema |
|---|---|---|---|
| `check` | `usage: rusolve check <model> <solution> [flags]` | check a solution against a model: every violated bound, row and integrality by name | `rusolve.check/1` |
| `classify` | `usage: rusolve classify <model> [flags]` | static instance features: MIPLIB row types, column and objective statistics | `rusolve.classify/1` |
| `convert` | `usage: rusolve convert <model> <output> [flags]` | write a model as CPLEX LP or MPS, by the output extension (.lp, .mps, .gz) | `rusolve.convert/1` |
| `diagnose` | `usage: rusolve diagnose <model> [flags]` | formulation or data? classify why a model is infeasible or unbounded | `rusolve.diagnose/1` |
| `dump` | `usage: rusolve dump <model>` | machine-readable model dump for differential testing |  |
| `ekk-seq` | `usage: rusolve ekk-seq <model>` | replay the HiGHS API oracle sequence on the port (acceptance harness) |  |
| `env` | `usage: rusolve env [flags]` | list every environment variable the solver reads |  |
| `explain` | `usage: rusolve explain <model> [flags]` | explain an infeasible model: an irreducible infeasible subsystem, by name | `rusolve.explain/1` |
| `feasrelax` | `usage: rusolve feasrelax <model> [flags]` | cheapest feasibility relaxation of an infeasible model | `rusolve.feasrelax/1` |
| `lint` | `usage: rusolve lint <model> [flags]` | static model lint: numerics, structure and modelling smells, by name | `rusolve.lint/1` |
| `mcp` | `usage: rusolve mcp` | Model Context Protocol server over stdio |  |
| `mip` | `usage: rusolve mip <model> [flags]` | solve a MIP (HiGHS port with rusolve's levers by default; RUSOLVE_MIP_HIGHS=0 for the native search) | `rusolve.result/1` |
| `mip-trace` | `usage: rusolve mip-trace <model> [time_limit_s]` | replay the HiGHS MIP oracle trace on the port (acceptance harness) |  |
| `options` | `usage: rusolve options [flags]` | list every solver option with type, range, default and what it affects |  |
| `presolve-dump` | `usage: rusolve presolve-dump <model>` | print the presolve reduction sequence of the port (acceptance harness) |  |
| `probe` | `usage: rusolve probe <model> [flags]` | short run on the port that reports dynamic instance features | `rusolve.probe/1` |
| `profile` | `usage: rusolve profile <subcommand> [profiles] [flags]` | show, validate, create and diff rusolve.profile/1 option profiles | `rusolve.profile-diff/1` |
| `ranging` | `usage: rusolve ranging <model> [flags]` | sensitivity ranging of an LP optimum, by row and column name | `rusolve.ranging/1` |
| `solve` | `usage: rusolve solve <model> [flags]` | solve an LP (HiGHS-port simplex by default; --legacy-lp / --ipm for the native engines) | `rusolve.result/1` |
| `tune` | `usage: rusolve tune <instances> [flags]` | race option candidates on an instance family and write the winning profile | `rusolve.tune/1` |
| `version` | `usage: rusolve version [flags]` | print the solver version and whether the CP-SAT engine's OR-Tools library is installed (no solve) |  |

## MCP tools (`rusolve mcp`, stdio)

Config: `{"mcpServers": {"rusolve": {"command": "/path/to/rusolve-cli", "args": ["mcp"]}}}`. Every tool but `load_model` takes the `model_id` that `load_model` returns. Details: docs/design/mcp.md.

### `load_model`

Load a model and return a model_id handle with its size, name summary, class and engine. Every other tool takes the model_id. Give exactly one of path, mps_text, lp_text (CPLEX LP format) or mof_text (MathOptFormat JSON). LP and MIP models get the full tool set. Convex QP, SOCP/QCQP and general-constraint models (indicator, SOS, piecewise-linear, min/max/abs/and/or, semi-continuous) are routed to their engine and support solve, get_solution and free_model. Convex MIQP and mixed-integer conic models load too, but solve runs their experimental outer-approximation engine only with options {"miqp_oa": true} or {"misocp_oa": true} (off by default: slower), and otherwise refuses with that hint. A class nothing solves (nonconvex Q, nonconvex quadratic rows, general constraints with quadratic terms) is refused with the class and the reason.

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lp_text` | string |  | The model as CPLEX LP-format text (Minimize/Maximize, Subject To, Bounds, General/Binary, End). A quadratic objective is written in brackets: obj: x + [ x^2 + 2 x * y ] / 2. |
| `mof_text` | string |  | The model as MathOptFormat JSON text (a .mof.json file's content). |
| `mps_text` | string |  | The model as fixed- or free-format MPS text. |
| `path` | string |  | Path of a model file: MPS, LP, AMPL .nl or MathOptFormat .mof.json, optionally .gz/.bz2/.xz/.zst. |

### `build_model`

Build an LP/MIP from JSON, no file needed, and return a model_id like load_model. An optional cp section adds scheduling and combinatorial objects (class cp): intervals [{name, start, size, end, presence?}], no_overlap [{name, intervals}], cumulative [{name, intervals, demands, capacity}], all_different [{name, variables}], element [{name, index, values, target}], table [{name, variables, tuples, negated?}]. Every variable a cp object names (start, end, presence, index, target, variables) must be declared in variables, type integer (binary for presence), with both bounds finite: upper defaults to infinity, so write it. An interval does not create its end: declare the end variable and name it; start, size and end are all required (only presence is optional). size, demands, values and capacity take an integer (a JSON number without a fraction, so 3 not 3.0) or a variable name; a size or demand must be nonnegative. no_overlap and cumulative name intervals by their interval name, not by variable. The reply is the handle summary; its model_id is in structuredContent and in the JSON text of content[0].text. solve checks the answer on these objects (envelope cp.verified); modify, explain, lint, ranging and feasrelax refuse such a model (RS4012). variables: [{name, type? continuous\|integer\|binary, lower?, upper?, objective?}] (bounds default 0 and infinity, null is infinite). rows: [{name, terms: {variable: coefficient}, then either sense (<=, >=, =) with rhs, or lower and/or upper}]. objective: {terms?: {variable: coefficient}, offset?} adds to the per-variable objective. sense is minimize (default) or maximize. A bad entry is an error naming its JSON path, for example rows[2].terms.z. For a quadratic or general-constraint model write LP text and use load_model.

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cp` | object |  | Scheduling and combinatorial objects. Every variable they name must be declared in variables as an integer (binary for presence) with finite lower and upper bounds. Variables and intervals are named by string. |
| `name` | string |  | Model name (no whitespace). |
| `objective` | object |  |  |
| `rows` | array |  |  |
| `sense` |  |  |  |
| `variables` | array | yes |  |

### `solve`

Solve the model handle (progress notifications with a progressToken, notifications/cancelled stops it) and return the rusolve.result/1 envelope (status, objective, dual bound, gap, stats.lp_iterations, run settings). After modify an LP re-solves from the kept basis (warm); set warm_start false to force a cold solve. Option values persist on the handle. On a convex MIQP or mixed-integer conic handle, options takes only {"miqp_oa": true} or {"misocp_oa": true} (experimental, off by default). With wasm_hook, a fuel-metered WebAssembly component scores branching and cuts and picks open nodes for this solve only; its counters appear as stats.wasm. options {"mip_engine": "cpsat"} solves an all-integer model, with or without CP objects, with OR-Tools CP-SAT when its library is installed (`rusolve version --format json` shows cpsat.available; a missing library is RS0012 naming the install routes); the answer is checked on your model and objects, and the envelope has a cpsat object.

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_solution` | boolean |  | Embed the incumbent by column name in the result. Default false; get_solution pages it instead. |
| `model_id` | string | yes | A handle returned by load_model. |
| `options` | object |  | Flat {option name: value} map applied with the HiGHS option setters (for example {"presolve": "off", "mip_rel_gap": 0.01}). Names are the registry's; `rusolve options --json` lists type, range, default and description of each. |
| `time_limit` | number |  | Seconds. |
| `warm_start` | boolean |  | false clears the kept basis first (a cold solve). Default true. |
| `wasm_fuel` | integer |  | Fuel (interpreter steps) per hook call with wasm_hook. Default 1000000; a call out of fuel falls back to the HiGHS rule. |
| `wasm_hook` | string |  | Path of a .wasm/.wat hook component (docs/design/wasm-hooks.md): branch/cut scores and node choice from sandboxed WebAssembly, applied to this solve only. A component can only reorder, never change the answer; a bad component is a tool error naming the file. |
| `wasm_memory` | integer |  | Linear-memory cap in bytes for the wasm_hook component. Default 1048576 (1 MiB); a component declaring more fails to load, which is a tool error naming the file. |

### `get_solution`

Column values of the last solve, by column name. Pass names for specific columns, or page through all of them with offset and limit (default 1000).

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer |  |  |
| `model_id` | string | yes | A handle returned by load_model. |
| `names` | array |  |  |
| `offset` | integer |  |  |

### `modify`

Apply edits by row/column name to the model handle: col_bounds, row_bounds, cost, coef, add_row, add_col, del_row, del_col. The basis is kept, so the next solve of an LP is warm. Edits apply in order; one that fails stops the batch (earlier edits stay applied).

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `edits` | array | yes |  |
| `model_id` | string | yes | A handle returned by load_model. |

### `check_solution`

Check a candidate solution against the model's bounds, rows and integrality, by name, and list the violations (rusolve.check/1). The solution is {"values": {column: value}} or {"columns": [{name, value}]} (a solve result with include_solution works).

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_findings` | integer |  |  |
| `mip_feasibility_tolerance` | number |  |  |
| `model_id` | string | yes | A handle returned by load_model. |
| `primal_feasibility_tolerance` | number |  |  |
| `solution` | object | yes |  |

### `explain`

Solve the model's LP (the relaxation for a MIP) and, when it is infeasible, return an irreducible infeasible set or Farkas certificate by row/column name; when unbounded, a primal ray (rusolve.explain/1). The certificate is verified unless verify is false.

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_members` | integer |  |  |
| `model_id` | string | yes | A handle returned by load_model. |
| `verify` | boolean |  |  |

### `lint`

Static modelling checks (big-M, coefficient ranges, scaling, empty rows/columns, near-parallel rows, ...) with a fix hint per finding (rusolve.lint/1).

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_items` | integer |  |  |
| `min_severity` |  |  |  |
| `model_id` | string | yes | A handle returned by load_model. |
| `rules` | array |  | Rule ids to run; default all. |
| `with_solve` | boolean |  | Also run the solve-based condition-estimate rule. |

### `ranging`

Cost and bound ranging, reduced costs, duals and basis status by name for an LP (for a MIP, on the LP with integers fixed at the incumbent) (rusolve.ranging/1). rows and cols are name patterns ('*' wildcard); default all.

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cols` | array |  |  |
| `model_id` | string | yes | A handle returned by load_model. |
| `rows` | array |  |  |

### `feasrelax`

For an infeasible model, the cheapest set of bound relaxations that makes it feasible, as named edits you can pass to modify (rusolve.feasrelax/1). mode weighted minimises the weighted violation; min-count minimises the number of relaxed constraints.

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `big_m` | number |  |  |
| `global_lower_penalty` | number |  |  |
| `global_rhs_penalty` | number |  |  |
| `global_upper_penalty` | number |  |  |
| `mode` |  |  |  |
| `model_id` | string | yes | A handle returned by load_model. |
| `penalties` | object |  | {"rows": {name: weight}, "cols": {name: {"lower": w, "upper": w}}}; a negative weight forbids relaxing. |
| `time_limit` | number |  |  |

### `free_model`

Release a model handle and its solver state.

| parameter | type | required | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model_id` | string | yes | A handle returned by load_model. |

## Options

342 options from `rusolve options --json` (the HiGHS option registry; set them with `--opt key=value`, `--options-file`, or the MCP `solve` tool's `options` map). `affects` says whether an option can change the search (`search`), only a tolerance (`tolerance`), only runtime behaviour (`runtime`) or only output (`output`). Run `rusolve options --json --non-default` to see what a run changed.

| option | type | default | range | affects | tunable | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allow_unbounded_or_infeasible` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Allow ModelStatus::kUnboundedOrInfeasible |
| `allowed_cost_scale_factor` | HighsInt | 0 | [0, 20] | search | yes | Largest power-of-two factor permitted when scaling the costs |
| `allowed_matrix_scale_factor` | HighsInt | 20 | [0, 30] | search | yes | Largest power-of-two factor permitted when scaling the constraint matrix |
| `blend_multi_objectives` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Blend multiple objectives or apply lexicographically |
| `centring_ratio_tolerance` | double | 100.0 | [0.0, inf] | tolerance | yes | Centring stops when the ratio max(x_js_j) / min(x_js_j) is below this tolerance (default = 100) |
| `cost_scale_factor` | HighsInt | 0 | [-20, 20] | search | yes | Scaling factor for costs |
| `dual_feasibility_tolerance` | double | 1e-07 | [1e-10, inf] | tolerance | yes | Dual feasibility tolerance |
| `dual_residual_tolerance` | double | 1e-07 | [1e-10, inf] | tolerance | yes | Dual residual tolerance |
| `dual_simplex_cost_perturbation_multiplier` | double | 1.0 | [0.0, inf] | search | yes | Dual simplex cost perturbation multiplier: 0 => no perturbation |
| `dual_simplex_pivot_growth_tolerance` | double | 1e-09 | [1e-12, inf] | tolerance | yes | Dual simplex pivot growth tolerance |
| `dual_steepest_edge_weight_error_tolerance` | double | inf | [0.0, inf] | tolerance | yes | Tolerance on dual steepest edge weight errors |
| `dual_steepest_edge_weight_log_error_threshold` | double | 10.0 | [1.0, inf] | search | yes | Threshold on dual steepest edge weight errors for Devex switch |

| `hipo_ordering` | string | choose |  | search | yes | HiPO matrix reordering: "choose", "metis", "amd" or "rcm" |
| `hipo_parallel_type` | string | both |  | search | yes | HiPO parallelism: "tree", "node", "both" or "choose" |
| `hipo_system` | string | choose |  | search | yes | HiPO Newton system: "choose", "augmented" or "normaleq" |
| `icrash` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Run iCrash |
| `icrash_approx_iter` | HighsInt | 50 | [0, 100] | search | yes | iCrash approximate minimization iterations |
| `icrash_breakpoints` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Exact subproblem solution for iCrash |
| `icrash_dualize` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Dualize strategy for iCrash |
| `icrash_exact` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Exact subproblem solution for iCrash |
| `icrash_iterations` | HighsInt | 30 | [0, 200] | search | yes | iCrash iterations |
| `icrash_starting_weight` | double | 0.001 | [1e-10, 1e+50] | search | yes | iCrash starting weight |
| `icrash_strategy` | string | ICA |  | output |  | Strategy for iCrash |
| `iis_strategy` | HighsInt | 0 | [0, 31] | search | yes | Strategy for IIS calculation: 0 => Light test; 1 => Try dual ray; 2 => Try elastic LP; 4 => Find true IIS; 8 => Prioritise columns; 16 => Find relaxation IIS for MIP |
| `iis_time_limit` | double | inf | [0.0, inf] | search | yes | Time limit for computing IIS (seconds) |
| `infinite_bound` | double | 1e+20 | [1000000000000000.0, inf] | search | yes | Limit on variable/constraint bound: values greater than or equal to this will be treated as infinite |
| `infinite_cost` | double | 1e+20 | [1000000000000000.0, inf] | search | yes | Limit on cost coefficient: values greater than or equal to this will be treated as infinite |
| `ipm_hipo_amd_first` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. HiPO analyses NE first and skips AS when NE is cheap; Metis only if AMD flops >= 1e9; default on |
| `ipm_hipo_cache_perm` | bool | true |  | search |  | Flag. HiPO replays a recorded permutation and column sort of the matrix instead of redoing it each factorisation; bit-identical |
| `ipm_hipo_dense_cols` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. HiPO keeps dense columns out of the normal-equations factor and recovers them by preconditioned CG (Andersen 1996; negative result) |
| `ipm_hipo_dense_schur` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. HiPO keeps up to 128 dense columns out of the normal-equations factor and adds them back by a Woodbury update inside CG (Andersen 1996; negative result) |
| `ipm_hipo_dualize` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. HiPO solves the dual of an LP with at least 3x more rows than columns, then maps the dual crossover basis back to the primal (Andersen-Andersen 1995, Gondzio 1997) |
| `ipm_hipo_fast_blas` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. HiPO uses a packed dgemm and grouped dtrsm instead of reference BLAS: AVX2/FMA or NEON 8x6 tile, 1.5-2x faster HiPO on fome13/nug08-3rd, not bit-identical |
| `ipm_hipo_par_ne` | bool | true |  | search |  | Flag. HiPO builds the normal-equations matrix on several threads, same summation order as serial, bit-identical |
| `ipm_hipo_stall_detect` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. HiPO stops when dual infeasibility stays flat while mu falls by 1e4 over 5 iterations, and the LP goes to IPX |
| `ipm_iteration_limit` | HighsInt | 2147483647 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Iteration limit for IPM solver |
| `ipm_optimality_tolerance` | double | 1e-08 | [1e-12, inf] | tolerance | yes | IPM optimality tolerance |
| `ipx_dualize_strategy` | HighsInt | 2 | [-1, 3] | search | yes | Strategy for dualizing before IPX |
| `kkt_tolerance` | double | 1e-07 | [1e-10, inf] | tolerance | yes | If changed from its default value, this tolerance is used for all feasibility and optimality (KKT) measures |
| `large_matrix_value` | double | 1000000000000000.0 | [1.0, inf] | search | yes | Upper limit on matrix entries: values greater than or equal to this will be treated as infinite |
| `less_infeasible_DSE_check` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Check whether LP is candidate for LiDSE |
| `less_infeasible_DSE_choose_row` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Use LiDSE if LP has right properties |
| `log_dev_level` | HighsInt | 0 | [0, 3] | output |  | Output development messages: 0 => none; 1 => info; 2 => detailed; 3 => verbose |
| `log_file` | string |  |  | output |  | Log file |
| `log_to_console` | bool | true |  | output |  | Enables or disables console logging |
| `lp_concurrent` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. With threads >= 2, race dual simplex against the HiPO interior point plus crossover on the LP; the first optimal wins |
| `lp_crossover_batch_push` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. IPX crossover push phase: superbasics are pushed to their bounds in groups with one FTRAN per group when no basic variable blocks, falling back to single pushes |
| `lp_crossover_ipm_crash` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. IPX crossover from a supplied interior point (the HiPO hand-off): crash basis ranks candidates by their distance to the bounds instead of by sparsity only |
| `lp_crossover_ipx_refine` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. HiPO then IPX crossover: IPX iterates on HiPO's point to a 100x tighter gap (1e-10) before the push phase |
| `lp_dual_devex_start` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. Dual simplex from a non-logical basis uses Devex instead of exact steepest edge weights |
| `lp_dualize_auto` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. Solve the presolved LP through its dual in simplex when it has at least 3x more rows than columns (Andersen-Andersen 1995, Gondzio 1997) |
| `lp_fold` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. Fold the LP by colour refinement, solve the quotient, lift and cross over |
| `lp_fold_basis` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. With lp_fold: lift the quotient basis and finish with simplex instead of crossover |
| `lp_ipm_failure_policy` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. Cold IPX restart after a HiPO failure, crossover on a near-optimal IPX stall, simplex on IPM error |
| `lp_ipm_support_reduction` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. After HiPO converges and before crossover, extra barrier iterations on a randomly cost-perturbed problem move the point to a low-support vertex of the optimal face |
| `lp_ipx_no_drop` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. IPX keeps every basic variable in the interior point solve (never drops one as implied), so the postprocessed point stays complementary for crossover |
| `lp_ipx_soft_drop` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. IPX drops a nonbasic only if z*x over its finite bounds is also within the drop tolerance (not on MIP analytic-centre solves) |
| `lp_postsolve_fix_tiny` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. The clean-up solve after postsolve fixes columns whose bound range is within the primal feasibility tolerance at their lower bound |
| `lp_postsolve_snap_basis` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. After postsolve, a nonbasic boxed variable gets the status of the bound its recovered value is at |
| `lp_presolve_requires_basis_postsolve` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Prevents LP presolve steps for which postsolve cannot maintain a basis: redundant option! |
| `lp_solver_auto` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Flag. With one thread and solver=choose, pick the HiPO interior point over simplex when the LP's structure predicts it wins; default on |
| `max_centring_steps` | HighsInt | 5 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Maximum number of steps to use (default = 5) when computing the analytic centre |
| `max_dual_simplex_cleanup_level` | HighsInt | 1 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Max level of dual simplex cleanup |
| `max_dual_simplex_phase1_cleanup_level` | HighsInt | 2 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Max level of dual simplex phase 1 cleanup |
| `mip_abs_gap` | double | 1e-06 | [0.0, inf] | tolerance | yes | Tolerance on absolute gap of MIP, ub-lb, to determine whether optimality has been reached for a MIP instance |
| `mip_activation_dff` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. Before presolve add up to two dual-feasible-function rows sum f(a_i) x_i <= y per activation knapsack sum a_i x_i <= b y of a model with an objective |
| `mip_aggregate_implications` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Ported behind this default-off lever: HiGHS #3562 #3596 |
| `mip_allow_cut_separation_at_nodes` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Whether cut separation at nodes other than the root node is permitted |
| `mip_allow_restart` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Whether MIP restart is permitted |

| `pdlp_optimality_tolerance` | double | 1e-07 | [1e-10, inf] | tolerance | yes | PDLP optimality tolerance |
| `pdlp_restart_strategy` | HighsInt | 2 | [0, 3] | search | yes | Restart strategy for PDLP solver: 0 => off; 1 => fixed; 2 => adaptive; 3 => Halpern |
| `pdlp_ruiz_iterations` | HighsInt | 10 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Number of Ruiz scaling iteraitons for PDLP solver |
| `pdlp_scaling_mode` | HighsInt | 5 | [0, 7] | search | yes | Scaling mode for PDLP solver (default = 5): 1 => Ruiz; 2 => L2; 4 => PC |
| `pdlp_step_size_strategy` | HighsInt | 1 | [0, 3] | search | yes | Step size strategy for PDLP solver: 0 => fixed; 1 => adaptive; 2 => Malitsky-Pock; 3 => PID |
| `presolve` | string | choose |  | search | yes | Presolve: "off", "choose" or "on" |
| `presolve_dep_eq_fixed_budget` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Default-off lever. The dependent-equations search of presolve gets its fixed 100 s cap instead of 1 % of time_limit, so presolve does not change with the time limit |
| `presolve_fm_obj_reformulation` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Fourier-Motzkin objective reformulation |
| `presolve_mode` | HighsInt | 0 | [0, 3] | search | yes | Presolve mode 0 => default; 1 => initial sweep; 2 => light; 3 => full |
| `presolve_pivot_threshold` | double | 0.01 | [0.0008, 0.5] | search | yes | Matrix factorization pivot threshold for substitutions in presolve |
| `presolve_reduction_limit` | HighsInt | -1 | [-1, 2147483647] | search | yes | Limit on number of presolve reductions -1 => no limit |
| `presolve_remove_slacks` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Remove slacks after presolve: redundant option! |
| `presolve_rule_logging` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Log effectiveness of presolve rules for LP |
| `presolve_rule_off` | HighsInt | 0 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Bit mask of presolve rules that are not allowed |
| `presolve_rule_test` | HighsInt | 0 | [0, 19] | search | yes | Presolve rule to test - DEV only! |
| `presolve_substitution_maxfillin` | HighsInt | 10 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Maximal fillin allowed for substitutions in presolve |
| `primal_feasibility_tolerance` | double | 1e-07 | [1e-10, inf] | tolerance | yes | Primal feasibility tolerance |
| `primal_residual_tolerance` | double | 1e-07 | [1e-10, inf] | tolerance | yes | Primal residual tolerance |
| `primal_simplex_bound_perturbation_multiplier` | double | 1.0 | [0.0, inf] | search | yes | Primal simplex bound perturbation multiplier: 0 => no perturbation |
| `qp_allow_hot_start` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Allow the active set QP solver to hot start |
| `qp_iteration_limit` | HighsInt | 2147483647 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Iteration limit for the active set QP solver |
| `qp_nullspace_limit` | HighsInt | 4000 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Nullspace limit for the active set QP solver |
| `qp_regularization_value` | double | 1e-07 | [0.0, inf] | search | yes | Regularization value added to the Hessian in the active set QP solver |
| `random_seed` | HighsInt | 0 | [0, 2147483647] | runtime |  | Random seed used in HiGHS |
| `rebuild_refactor_solution_error_tolerance` | double | 1e-08 | [-inf, inf] | tolerance | yes | Tolerance on solution error when considering refactorization on simplex rebuild |
| `restart_presolve_reduction_limit` | HighsInt | -1 | [-1, 2147483647] | search | yes | Limit on number of further presolve reductions on restart in MIP solver -1 => no limit, otherwise, must be positive |
| `run_centring` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Perform centring steps or not |
| `run_crossover` | string | on |  | search | yes | Run IPM crossover: "off", "choose" or "on" |
| `simplex_dual_edge_weight_strategy` | HighsInt | -1 | [-1, 2] | search | yes | Strategy for simplex dual edge weights: Choose / Dantzig / Devex / Steepest Edge (-1/0/1/2) |
| `simplex_dualize_strategy` | HighsInt | -1 | [-1, 1] | search | yes | Strategy for dualizing before simplex |
| `simplex_iteration_limit` | HighsInt | 2147483647 | [0, 2147483647] | search | yes | Iteration limit for simplex solver when solving LPs, but not subproblems in the MIP solver |
| `simplex_max_concurrency` | HighsInt | 8 | [1, 8] | search | yes | Maximum level of concurrency in parallel simplex |
| `simplex_min_concurrency` | HighsInt | 1 | [1, 8] | search | yes | Minimum level of concurrency in parallel simplex |
| `simplex_permute_strategy` | HighsInt | -1 | [-1, 1] | search | yes | Strategy for permuting before simplex |
| `simplex_price_strategy` | HighsInt | 3 | [0, 3] | search | yes | Strategy for PRICE in simplex |
| `simplex_primal_edge_weight_strategy` | HighsInt | -1 | [-1, 2] | search | yes | Strategy for simplex primal edge weights: Choose / Dantzig / Devex / Steepest Edge (-1/0/1/2) |
| `simplex_scale_strategy` | HighsInt | 2 | [0, 4] | search | yes | Simplex scaling strategy: off / choose / equilibration (default) / forced equilibration / max value (0/1/2/3/4) |
| `simplex_strategy` | HighsInt | 1 | [0, 4] | search | yes | Strategy for simplex solver 0 => Choose; 1 => Dual (serial); 2 => Dual (SIP); 3 => Dual (PAMI); 4 => Primal |
| `simplex_unscaled_solution_strategy` | HighsInt | 1 | [0, 2] | search | yes | Strategy for solving unscaled LP in simplex |
| `simplex_update_limit` | HighsInt | 5000 | [0, 2147483647] | runtime |  | Limit on the number of simplex UPDATE operations |
| `small_matrix_value` | double | 1e-09 | [1e-12, inf] | search | yes | Lower limit on matrix entries: values less than or equal to this will be treated as zero |
| `solve_relaxation` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Solve the relaxation of discrete model components |
| `solver` | string | choose |  | search | yes | LP/QP solver: "choose", "simplex", "ipm", "ipx", "hipo", "pdlp", "qpasm" or "hipdlp", |
| `start_crossover_tolerance` | double | 1e-08 | [1e-12, inf] | tolerance | yes | Tolerance to be satisfied before IPM crossover will start |
| `threads` | HighsInt | 0 | [0, 2147483647] | runtime |  | Maximum number of threads used by HiGHS (0: automatic) |
| `time_limit` | double | inf | [0.0, inf] | search | yes | Time limit (seconds) |
| `timeless_log` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Suppression of time-based data in logging |
| `use_implied_bounds_from_presolve` | bool | false |  | search | yes | Use relaxed implied bounds from presolve: redundant option! |
| `use_warm_start` | bool | true |  | search | yes | Use any warm start that is available |
| `user_bound_scale` | HighsInt | 0 | [-2147483647, 2147483647] | search | yes | Exponent of power-of-two bound scaling for model |
| `user_objective_scale` | HighsInt | 0 | [-2147483647, 2147483647] | search | yes | Exponent of power-of-two objective scaling for model |

## Environment variables

148 variables from `rusolve env --json`. Only `lever` and `profile` variables are for users: `harness` and `debug` ones exist for benchmarking and tracing. Prefer an option over a variable. An unregistered `RUSOLVE_*` name makes the CLI exit 2 with the nearest registered name.

| variable | kind | scope | values | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `P42_COLD` | harness | legacy_lp | set = on | Times the cold `factor_sparse` path in the `factor_ws_timing` probe instead of the recycled-workspace path. |
| `P42_REPS` | harness | legacy_lp | a repetition count (default 50) | Repetitions of the ignored `factor_ws_timing` timing probe in rusolve-lp's LU tests. |
| `PD_DETAIL` | debug | port_mip | set = on | `rusolve presolve-dump`: appends the rows and columns each recorded reduction touched. |
| `RUSOLVE_AGG_FUZZ_FROM` | harness | legacy_lp | a seed number (default 1) | Seed the aggregator differential fuzz test starts from; it checks presolve-ON against presolve-OFF on random equality-heavy LPs. rusolve-lp unit test only; never read by a shipped solve. |
| `RUSOLVE_AGG_FUZZ_SEEDS` | harness | legacy_lp | a seed count (default 400) | Last seed (so seed count) of the aggregator differential fuzz test against presolve off. rusolve-lp unit test only; never read by a shipped solve. |
| `RUSOLVE_AUDIT` | debug | native_mip | set = on, 0 = off | Native `rusolve mip`: prints `audit ...` stderr lines and per-LP timings for the gap audit, without changing the search. |
| `RUSOLVE_AUTOPSY_EVERY` | lever | legacy_lp | an iteration period (default 64) | With RUSOLVE_DEBUG=1, run the dual autopsy (ground-truth recomputation of the dual state) every N iterations instead of 64. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_BENCH_MPS` | harness | legacy_lp | comma-separated MPS paths | Extra instances the ipm_chol criterion benchmark adds to its matrix set; unreadable paths are skipped. |
| `RUSOLVE_BIN` | harness | any | a path to a rusolve-cli binary | Which binary the tools/diff differential scripts run. The solver itself ignores it; it is registered because the scripts' children inherit it. |
| `RUSOLVE_BLAND_AFTER` | lever | legacy_lp | a pivot count (default 25) | Stall threshold in pivots after which the Bland anti-cycling rule engages; a huge value keeps Bland out of the solve entirely. |
| `RUSOLVE_BLAND_EPISODE` | lever | legacy_lp | a pivot count (default 25) | Budget of the bounded Bland episode: Bland is released early on non-degenerate pivots and re-entry needs doubled thresholds; 0 restores sticky Bland. |
| `RUSOLVE_BRANCH` | lever | native_mip | a `BranchConfig::apply` spec string | Branching-spec string applied to the native MIP's `BranchConfig` before its flags, for A/B runs through scripts that pass no flags; a bad spec is a usage error. |
| `RUSOLVE_BT_GATE` | lever | legacy_lp | a ratio (default 4.0) | Cost gate on the BTRAN eta pattern walk: it switches to the pattern walk when that is this factor cheaper; bit-exact either way, so it moves cost, not the pivot path. |
| `RUSOLVE_CUT_DEBUG` | debug | native_mip | set = on | Native MIP cut generation: prints per-separator cut counts, violations and stripping decisions to stderr. |
| `RUSOLVE_DEBUG` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy-engine trace output: presolve rule applications, simplex and dual audits, SH-autopsy and terminal-state checks. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_DEBUG_SOL_ABORT` | debug | ekk | set to exactly 1 | Port MIP: makes a violated HighsDebugSol check panic instead of logging to stderr. |
| `RUSOLVE_DENSE_LU` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | A/B lever back to the dense LU factorization for the legacy simplex, whose default is the sparse engine. |
| `RUSOLVE_DPROG` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy dual simplex: prints a progress line every 500 iterations. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_DTRACE` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy dual simplex: prints `dtrace` lines for the z identity, the leaving row and the entering column of each pivot. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_ACC` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Dual accuracy regime; the CLI default is on and `=0` is the lever back to the earlier accuracy handling. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_ACC_PARTS` | lever | legacy_lp | a bitmask integer | Selects which parts of the dual accuracy regime stay on (bit 0 skips the refinement rounds), used to price each part separately. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_AUDIT_INC` | lever | legacy_lp | an audit-pricing spec string | Lever: prices the dual audit incrementally instead of recomputing every audited reduced cost. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_BACKTRACK` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Enables backtracking when a dual ratio step turns out not to be a genuine decrease. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_CORRECT` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Lever: repairs accumulated dual infeasibility by an explicit correction step. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_CTIE` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Breaks CHUZC ties (equal \|a\| in the pivot group) by a hashed permutation of the variable index instead of the lowest index. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_DEBTSHIFT` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (default off) | Lever: a flip-only/saturate step's dual advance is treated as a debt only a pivot on the same row pays, instead of being kept as the edge offset. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_DINF` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Diagnostic: traces the sign of the leaving row's dual before the step and the row's infeasibility after it. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_DSE` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Dual steepest-edge weights (Forrest & Goldfarb 1992); `=0` is the lever back to Dantzig pricing. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_FLIPPIV` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = flip-only, 1 = pivot in warm too | Lever on the flip-prefix exits: `=0` keeps the flip-only offset commit, `=1` also pivots in warm (MIP node) re-solves. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_HANDOVER` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Hands a stalling solve over to the fresh-pi path at the first ladder rung, as a safety net on the incremental-d path. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_HARRIS` | lever | legacy_lp | a Harris-relaxation factor | Lever: applies Harris' relaxed pivot test to the dual entering column above the given strength. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_HARRIS_GATE` | lever | legacy_lp | a ratio | Lever: the best-pivot gate below which the Harris relaxation is applied. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_HCHUZR` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = never, 1 = large LPs, 2 = always | Lever: hyper CHUZR (choose the leaving row from a hyper-sparse candidate set) instead of the full violation scan. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_HGROUP` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Lever: HiGHS' Harris-relaxed BFRT grouping for the dual ratio test. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_INCD` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Keeps reduced costs incrementally instead of recomputing them from pi every pass, on LPs above the nnz cutoff. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_INCP` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (default off) | Lever: carries the dual point forward incrementally instead of re-anchoring pi by a full BTRAN of the basic costs every iteration. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_INCP_CAD` | lever | legacy_lp | a re-anchor period | Cadence of the periodic pi re-anchor on the incremental-dual path. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_INF_LIST` | lever | legacy_lp | a fraction of m (default 0.05, 0 disables) | Hyper-sparse CHUZR (Hall & McKinnon 2005): take the leaving row from the infeasible-basics list while it is at most this fraction of the rows. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_KEEPSHIFT` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Keeps a cost shift on a column after it enters the basis (as HiGHS does); `=0` restores release-on-entry. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_LARGE_ALPHA` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (default off) | HiGHS `chooseFinalLargeAlpha`: when the BFRT walk's final group holds no usable pivot, back off to the last earlier group with a large alpha. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_NOPERT` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (disables perturbation) | Skips the hash-signed sub-tolerance cost perturbation that otherwise engages once a plateau/stall survives the tie-scoring overlay. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_PERT` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | HiGHS' up-front cost perturbation of cold dual solves; `=0` is the lever off. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_PERT_SEED` | lever | legacy_lp | an integer seed (default 0) | Seed of the HiGHS-style cost perturbation hash, for A/B runs over perturbation seeds. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_PICHECK` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | At every pi re-anchor on the incremental path, measures the drift the anchor erases and reports it (a measurement lever). |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_RESCAN_SKIP` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (default off) | Lever: skips the fresh-pi ratio-pass rescan for columns already priced this pass. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_RFCAD` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Applies the dual engine's refactor-clock scale (4.0) to its factorizations; `=0` keeps the primal's calibrated clock. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_ROWPRICE` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Row-wise PRICE for the dual's duals update on large LPs; `=0` falls back to column-wise PRICE. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_RTIE` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Breaks CHUZR ties (equal DSE score) by a hashed permutation of the row index instead of the lowest index. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_SHIFT0` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, 1 = no shiftBack, 2 = default | Zero-step cost shift mode: 2 shifts and shifts back, 1 shifts only, 0 is the lever off. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_STATS` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy engine: per-solve cost counters for the dual, PFI and factorization, dumped as one line each to stderr. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_TA` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (default off) | HiGHS' update-count dependent CHUZC pivot tolerance (HEkkDualRow::choosePossible) in place of the flat pivot tolerance. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_WATCH` | lever | legacy_lp | a column index | Diagnostic: prints that column's dual, reduced cost, state and candidate position at every pivot. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_ZCHECK` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy dual simplex: checks the dual objective z against a recomputed identity and reports drift. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_ZFLOOR` | lever | legacy_lp | a multiplier K (see ZGAIN_FLOOR_K) | Lever: the z-gain noise-floor multiplier of the plateau ladder; `0` disables the floor. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_ZLAZY` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = per-visit pass, anything else = lazy | Lever: on large LPs the plateau ladder skips the z pass while the stall count is below half the Bland threshold. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_ZNET` | lever | legacy_lp | a lag in visits | Lever: the ladder's z test compares against the z of the last gain this many visits back, so one dip does not re-arm the plateau window. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_ZTHRESH` | lever | legacy_lp | a tolerance (default 1e-6) | How far the recomputed dual objective may drift from the maintained one before zcheck reports it. |
| `RUSOLVE_DUAL_ZTRACE` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy dual simplex: prints each ladder event's delta-z alongside the state identity. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_EKK` | lever | any | 0 = legacy simplex, any other value = ekk | Engine choice for `rusolve solve`: forces the HiGHS-port ekk engine, or with `=0` the legacy simplex; it beats the legacy-lever census rule and loses only to `--ipm`. |
| `RUSOLVE_EKK_HIPO` | lever | ekk | 0 = off, anything else = on | Makes the HiPO interior point code available to the ekk LP path (`hipo_available`), so `solver=ipm` runs HiPO then IPX as HiGHS 1.15+ does; off routes `solver=ipm` to IPX. |
| `RUSOLVE_EKK_LOG` | debug | ekk | 0 = off, anything else = on | Keeps the HiGHS log of the ekk LP path on the console (its `output_flag`). |
| `RUSOLVE_EKK_OPTS` | lever | ekk | comma-separated `key=value` HiGHS options | Sets HiGHS options by name on the ekk LP path before the solve; an unknown option or invalid value is an error. |
| `RUSOLVE_EKK_PRESOLVE` | lever | ekk | a HiGHS presolve string (`off` disables) | Overrides the ekk path's `presolve` option; `off` keeps the bit-exact presolve-off path, unset keeps the HiGHS default (`choose`). |
| `RUSOLVE_FIXTURES_DIR` | harness | ekk | a directory path | Replaces the whole oracle fixture set: the manifest and every fixture are read from that directory only, for running the port against another HiGHS version's oracle output. |
| `RUSOLVE_FT` | lever | legacy_lp | `1` or `on` = enabled | Selects the Forrest-Tomlin updated factorization for the legacy simplex instead of the product-form eta file. |
| `RUSOLVE_GIT` | harness | any | a 12-hex commit, optionally with -dirty | Compile-time only: build.rs sets it from `git rev-parse` and the envelope reports it as `solver.git`. Setting it at run time changes nothing. |
| `RUSOLVE_HIGHS_FIXTURES` | harness | ekk | a directory path | Extra directory searched first for target-only oracle fixtures (generated by tools/highs-oracle), before `target/highs-fixtures`. |
| `RUSOLVE_HIPO_PROF` | debug | ekk | unset = off, anything else = on | Times every HiPO BLAS call and the dense-factor phases (summed thread seconds and call counts) and prints the table in the HiPO summary. |
| `RUSOLVE_HIPO_TRACE` | debug | ekk | a file path | Port HiPO interior-point code: truncates and appends its oracle-trace lines to that file, for the C++/Rust trace diff. |
| `RUSOLVE_INSTALL_BASE_URL` | harness | any | a base URL the release archives are downloaded from | Installer only: where install.sh downloads from. The solver ignores it; it is registered because the installer's children inherit it and unknown RUSOLVE_* names are rejected. |
| `RUSOLVE_INSTALL_MARKETPLACE` | harness | any | a GitHub owner/repo, a git URL or a local path | Installer only: the plugin marketplace install.sh adds for the rusolve skills (default CREAIT-nl/rusolve). The solver ignores it; it is registered because the installer's children inherit it and unknown RUSOLVE_* names are rejected. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Routes `rusolve solve` to the interior-point LP instead of the simplex (the same thing `--ipm` does). |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_ADAPT` | lever | legacy_lp | a factor, 0 = off (default 1) | Raises rho and delta when a factorization hits Theta-cancellation pivots in the legacy IPM. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_DELTA` | lever | legacy_lp | a number (default DELTA_DEFAULT) | Dual regularization delta (M += delta*I) of the legacy IPM. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_DENSE` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = never, 1 = cost model (default), 2 = always | Dense-column splitting policy of the legacy IPM's normal-equations factorization. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_DENSE_MODREL` | lever | legacy_lp | a relative threshold (default 1e-8) | A sparse-part pivot at or below this fraction of M_jj is modified rather than skipped (Andersen 1996). |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_DEPREL` | lever | legacy_lp | a relative threshold (default DEP_REL, 0 disables) | Tiny-pivot threshold of the structural-dependence probe on the legacy IPM's starting factor. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_LOG` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy IPM: prints per-iteration and factorization diagnostics to stderr. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_MAXIT` | lever | legacy_lp | an iteration count (default 200) | Maximum IPM iterations for `rusolve solve --ipm`. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_PIVPERT` | lever | legacy_lp | a relative perturbation (default 0 = off) | When above 0, tiny pivots in the IPM's normal-equations factorization are perturbed to this fraction of M_jj instead of skipped. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_PIVREL` | lever | legacy_lp | a relative threshold (default 1e-14) | Relative tiny-pivot threshold: a pivot at or below this fraction of M_jj counts as cancellation noise (Wright 1999). |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_REG_DECAY` | lever | legacy_lp | a decay factor (default 1 = keep the raise) | How fast a regularization raise on rho/delta decays back toward its starting value. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_RELAX` | lever | legacy_lp | an artificial-flop ratio (default 0.02, 0 = off) | Upper target for the artificial-flop ratio of relaxed amalgamation in the IPM's symbolic factorization (HiPO kUpperRatioRelax). |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_RETRY_REG` | lever | legacy_lp | a regularization value (<= 0 disables) | When the first IPM run ends NoProgress or Imprecise, retry once with rho = delta = this value. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_RHO` | lever | legacy_lp | a number (default RHO_DEFAULT) | Primal regularization rho of the legacy IPM (Theta inverse += rho). |
| `RUSOLVE_IPM_THREADS` | lever | legacy_lp | a thread count, 0 = all cores (default 1) | Factorization threads of the legacy IPM; the default keeps the run single-threaded like every other rusolve path. |
| `RUSOLVE_IPX_TRACE` | debug | ekk | a file path | Port IPX interior-point code: truncates and appends its oracle-trace lines to that file, for the C++/Rust trace diff. |
| `RUSOLVE_LOCALMIP_LOG` | debug | native_mip | set = on | Native MIP: prints the local-MIP sub-solve's progress lines to stderr. |
| `RUSOLVE_LP_LOG` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy engine: prints the presolve reduction (rows, columns and nonzeros before and after) for the LP-gap decomposition. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_LS_STATS` | debug | ekk | set to exactly 1 | Port MIP: prints the FJ, local-MIP and FPR heuristic counters (calls, commits, effort per second) at the end of the solve. |
| `RUSOLVE_LU_HSKIP` | lever | legacy_lp | a mode integer 0-3 (default 3) | Selects among the Markowitz high-skip search modes of the sparse LU factorization; the modes are bit-identical, so only the cost moves. |
| `RUSOLVE_MIP_AC_FIXTURE` | harness | ekk | a path to a `.ac` fixture | Port MIP: replays the oracle's analytic-centre/IPM records from that file instead of computing them, so a trace diff isolates divergence before the call. |
| `RUSOLVE_MIP_EKK` | lever | native_mip | 0 = off, anything else = on | Native MIP: uses the ported HiGHS simplex (ekk) as the node LP engine instead of the rusolve engine. |
| `RUSOLVE_MIP_HIGHS` | lever | port_mip | 0 = native search, anything else or unset = HiGHS port | `rusolve mip` runs the rusolve-ekk HiGHS MIP port by default (the envelope, `--opt` and the documented exit codes exist only on that path); `0` selects the native rusolve-mip search. |
| `RUSOLVE_MIP_LOG` | debug | native_mip | set = on | Native MIP: prints presolve, cut-round, restart, clique and branching-tree progress lines to stderr. |
| `RUSOLVE_NODE_ROUNDING_DRY` | debug | ekk | set to exactly 1 | Port MIP, with mip_node_rounding on: count and log to stderr the improving points the node rounding finds without adding them, so the search is the one without it. |
| `RUSOLVE_NO_P1REPERT` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (lever back) | Turns off phase-1 re-perturbation, which by default re-perturbs a frozen epsilon across a stall window. |
| `RUSOLVE_NO_P2PERT` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (lever back) | Turns off phase-2 entering-tie perturbation, which by default engages after 4x the Bland stall threshold. |
| `RUSOLVE_NO_RELAXED` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (disables the escape) | Suppresses the phase-1 escape into relaxed row choice after a long frozen-and-stagnant stall. |
| `RUSOLVE_NO_SH` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (lever back) | Turns off SH (strong-Harris) pricing, falling back to Dantzig pricing in the legacy simplex. |
| `RUSOLVE_ORTOOLS_LIB` | lever | port_mip | path of the OR-Tools shared library file (libortools.so.9, libortools.9.dylib, ortools.dll) | Where `mip_engine=cpsat` loads OR-Tools CP-SAT from. First step of the search order (`crates/rusolve-cpsat/src/runtime.rs`, docs/design/cpsat-engine.md); when set, no other place is tried. Unset: the install prefix, the `ortools` Python package, then the system loader. Only read when the engine is selected, so the default search does not depend on it. |
| `RUSOLVE_P1PROBE` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy phase 1: every 20,000 stalled pivots at a frozen vertex, probes whether any improver column has a strictly positive ratio. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_P1TRACE` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy phase 1: collects and prints the phase-1 trace (w probe and stall census) for the artificial phase. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_P1_ROUTE_DUAL` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Policy arm: with RUSOLVE_PRIMAL=1, cold primal-infeasible starts go to the dual engine instead of paying an artificial-basis phase 1. |
| `RUSOLVE_PARCOLDOM_FUZZ_DUMP` | harness | legacy_lp | a seed number | Seed whose generated parallel-column LP the dominance fuzz test dumps to stderr before checking it. rusolve-lp unit test only; never read by a shipped solve. |
| `RUSOLVE_PARCOLDOM_FUZZ_SEEDS` | harness | legacy_lp | a seed count (default 400) | How many random parallel-column LPs the column-dominance differential fuzz test checks against presolve off. rusolve-lp unit test only; never read by a shipped solve. |
| `RUSOLVE_PDLP_TRACE` | debug | ekk | a file path | Port PDLP code: truncates and appends its oracle-trace lines to that file, for the C++/Rust trace diff. |
| `RUSOLVE_PFI_DEBUG` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy engine: prints what the factorization did with a singular sparse LU, including the no-dense-fallback case. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_PFI_DENSE_MAX` | lever | legacy_lp | a basis dimension (default 4096) | Above this basis size a singular sparse LU is no longer retried with the dense engine, and the singularity propagates. |
| `RUSOLVE_PRESOLVE_AGG` | lever | legacy_lp | 0 = off, anything else = on | Legacy presolve's general-scale duplicate-column aggregator; `=0` is the lever back. |
| `RUSOLVE_PRESOLVE_HASH` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy presolve: prints an FNV-1a hash over the exact bits of the reduced LP, so two builds can be proven to apply identical reductions. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_PRESOLVE_PROF` | debug | any | unset = off, anything else = on | Prints one `presolve_prof` line on stderr per presolve: wall seconds and calls of each phase of the HiGHS-port presolve main loop. |
| `RUSOLVE_PRESOLVE_STATS` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy presolve: prints per-rule effectiveness counters (what each reduction removed). Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_PRIMAL` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (lever back) | Runs `rusolve solve` with the primal simplex; the default engine is the dual simplex by measurement on our benchmark set. |
| `RUSOLVE_PROFILE` | profile | any | `recommended` (default) or `highs-1.15.1` | Base HiGHS option set every CLI solve starts from; `highs-1.15.1` turns every H16 option off, and any other value is a usage error. |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_IMPEQ` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (default off) | Enables the implied-equality conversion in the legacy presolve, which measured harmful and stayed behind the lever. |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_MEMGUARD_BYTES` | lever | legacy_lp | a byte budget (0 disables the guard) | Overrides the presolve memory-guard budget above which the reduction loop is skipped for the lpopt giant tier. |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_NO_FOLD` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | A/B lever: disables the legacy presolve's bound-fold mutation only, for per-instance regression hunting. |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_NO_FORCECOL` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | A/B lever: disables the forcing-column mutation only; the detection probe keeps counting under RUSOLVE_PRESOLVE_STATS. |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_NO_MEMGUARD` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Disables the presolve memory guard so giant LPs are reduced regardless of the fitted working-set estimate. |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_NO_PARCOL` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (lever back) | Lever back for the general-scale duplicate-column merge in the legacy presolve. |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_NO_PARCOLDOM` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (lever back) | Lever back for the parallel-column dominance arms of the legacy presolve. |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_NO_PARROW` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | A/B lever: disables the parallel-row merge mutation only. |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_NO_PARROWEQ` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | A/B lever: disables only the cross-sense interval-collapse arm of the parallel-row rule (the same-sense merge stays under RUSOLVE_PS_NO_PARROW). |
| `RUSOLVE_PS_NO_VUBEQ` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (lever back) | Lever back for the singleton-equality (variable-bound equality) rule in the legacy presolve. |
| `RUSOLVE_QP_TRACE` | debug | ekk | a file path | Port QP solver code: truncates and appends its oracle-trace lines to that file, for the C++/Rust trace diff. |
| `RUSOLVE_REFINE_AGE` | lever | legacy_lp | a fraction in (0, 1] | Skips the iterative refinement of a PFI solve whose basis is younger than this fraction of the refactor age; path-visible, so the iteration gate adjudicates it. |
| `RUSOLVE_REFINE_GATE` | lever | legacy_lp | set to exactly 1 | Makes the PFI round-0 correction conditional on the double-word residual clearing the fp floor, saving a raw solve when it already sits there. |
| `RUSOLVE_REQUIRE_TARGET_FIXTURES` | harness | any | set to exactly 1 | Turns a missing target-only oracle fixture from a SKIP banner into a test failure, for CI gates. |
| `RUSOLVE_RFCAD` | lever | legacy_lp | `K[:M]` (K >= 1, M a minimum-update floor) | Retunes the refactor clock of every factorization: K raises the clock threshold to K * build_work, M floors the update count. |
| `RUSOLVE_RFDROP` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Enables the per-refactor drift probe, which needs RUSOLVE_DUAL_STATS=1 and exists for measurement builds only. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_S2_STATS` | debug | ekk | set to exactly 1 | Port MIP conflict resolution: prints the `s2-stats` counters line when the conflict separator adds rows. |
| `RUSOLVE_S2_TRACE` | debug | ekk | set to exactly 1 | Port MIP conflict resolution: prints the first invalid conflict row as a diagnostic, without changing the solve. |
| `RUSOLVE_S2_TRACE_DUMP` | debug | ekk | set to exactly 1 | With RUSOLVE_S2_TRACE=1, also dumps the terms of the first invalid conflict row. |
| `RUSOLVE_S3_DEBUG_SOL` | debug | ekk | a path to a solution file | Port MIP dynamic symmetry: reads a known-optimal solution and checks the dynamic symmetry-breaking decisions against it. |
| `RUSOLVE_SCALE` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on (default off) | Enables power-of-2 equilibration scaling in the legacy simplex, which helped some instances and stalled others. |
| `RUSOLVE_SCALE_DEBUG` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy scaling: prints whether the improvement gate accepted the scaling and by how much. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_SPARSE` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Lever: runs the direct CSC-only `Standard` build for `rusolve solve` when presolve and dual are off. |
| `RUSOLVE_STATS_EVERY` | lever | legacy_lp | an iteration period | With RUSOLVE_DUAL_STATS=1, dumps the cost counters every N iterations so a time-limited run still reports them. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
| `RUSOLVE_STD_LIBSTDCXX` | lever | port_mip | 1 = libstdc++ tie order, anything else or unset = libc++ | Port MIP: the C++ heap operations (priority_queue, make/pop/sort_heap, partial_sort) break ties as libstdc++ does (the Linux highspy wheel) instead of libc++ (the macOS oracle the identity references come from). Only heap operations switch (not HighsMultiBuckets order, the pdqsort heap fallback, IPX RandomPermute, or FMA contraction), so it is not a general bit-exact oracle. Diagnostic, default off. |
| `RUSOLVE_SUBMIP_LOG` | debug | native_mip | set = on | Native MIP: prints the root sub-MIP's progress lines to stderr. |
| `RUSOLVE_TEST_PROFILE` | harness | ekk | `default`, `recommended` or `all-h16` | Base HighsOptions the port's replay test builders start from, before the oracle records override what they carry. |
| `RUSOLVE_TREE_TRACE` | debug | ekk | set to exactly 1 | Port MIP main search: print one line per dive (TD), evaluated node (TN), queue pick (TQ) and restart (TR) to stderr. Reporting only; the search is unchanged. |
| `RUSOLVE_VUBEQ_FUZZ_DUMP` | harness | legacy_lp | a seed number | Seed whose generated LP the singleton-equality fuzz test dumps to stderr before checking it. rusolve-lp unit test only; never read by a shipped solve. |
| `RUSOLVE_VUBEQ_FUZZ_SEEDS` | harness | legacy_lp | a seed count (default 400) | How many random LPs with an appended singleton-cost row the singleton-equality fuzz test checks against presolve off. rusolve-lp unit test only; never read by a shipped solve. |
| `RUSOLVE_VUBEQ_FUZZ_VERBOSE` | harness | legacy_lp | set = on | Prints each seed as the singleton-equality fuzz test runs it, so a failure names its seed. rusolve-lp unit test only; never read by a shipped solve. |
| `RUSOLVE_WARM_INCD_MIN_NNZ` | lever | legacy_lp | an nnz count (default 10000) | Nonzero count from which the incremental reduced costs also engage on warm (MIP node) re-solves. |
| `RUSOLVE_WARM_STATS` | lever | legacy_lp | set = on | Legacy dual simplex: accumulates the warm-start census (calls, warm vs fallback, timing) and prints it at the end. Read only by the legacy engine, so setting it also selects that engine (`use_ekk_engine`). |
